senses.gloss: flower, knob on the top of the central stem of the palm branch (Lulab).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 3:1:5">Y. Succ. III, beg. 53ᶜ</cite> <he>יבשה צִיצָתוֹ</he> (ed. Krot., a. Asheri to <cite ref="Sukkah 3a">Succ. I</cite>II, beg. <he>צִיצִיתוֹ</he>; Asheri quotes a Var. <he>יבשו הוצין</he>) if the top of the branch is withered.
<cite ref="Gittin 56a:8">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>שהיתה ציצתו נגררת וכ׳</he> the fringes of his cloak were dragged along on cushions.

<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 3:4">M. Kat. III, 4</cite> <he>תכלת לציצתו</he> Y. ed. (Mish. a. Bab. ed. 19ᵃ <he>לציציתו</he>; Rabb. D. S. quotes <he>לציצתו</he>) the blue thread for his show-fringes.—

Kel. XVI, 4 סקורטיא … ויעשה את צִיצָתָהּ (Ar. ציציתיה, read: צִיצוֹתֶיהָ) a leather apron is considered finished, when … he attaches its fringes (cords); [Maim.: a leather table cloth …, when he puts on a bright center piece].—Pl. צִיצוֹת, v. supra.
